verdict.rationale: dlt is an open-source Python library that can be installed and run entirely locally/self-hosted (pip install, run on laptop, Airflow, Lambda, containers, etc.) with no mandatory dependency on a hosted service; core execution and destinations like local DuckDB are fully self-hostable. missing for 10: no independent hands-on report specifically confirming a fully air-gapped self-hosted deployment (only vendor docs and GitHub, plus community praise for its lightweight local usage).
